dimensions.problem_fit: Strong Fit for standardizing content briefs and establishing clear factual boundaries between local business owners and writers.
dimensions.workflow_fit: Workflow Compatible with Stage 2 Brief; structures intent classification, outline hierarchy, and editorial checklists cleanly.
dimensions.usability: High usability with an editorial-first brief builder designed specifically for content managers and practitioners.
dimensions.capability: Robust brief generation including visual asset requirements, search intent cards, competitor outline comparisons, and custom questions.
dimensions.evidence: Evidence Available with Strong empirical results from Benchmark Test 04 and documented case studies.
dimensions.integration: Workflow Compatible via shareable web links, Google Docs synchronizing, and structured PDF exports.
dimensions.value: Moderate value for solopreneurs due to credit-based pricing; high value for multi-location businesses managing multiple content writers.
dimensions.limitations: Requires Human Oversight to prune national clinical suggestions and enforce strict local clinic constraints.

summary: Content Harmony demonstrates Strong Fit for CAP-BRF-01, excelling at creating comprehensive, shareable editorial briefs.
